summary: Verified the parser_files reassign bug fix end-to-end. Backend layer fully passing (7/7 pytest), including the full lifecycle: persist a tiny .txt under a local-xxx id via /api/parser/parse-rfq → POST /api/parser/files/reassign with from_id=local-xxx,to_id=draft-uuid → GET /api/parser/files?quote_id=draft-uuid returns the file with stable file_id → reassign draft→quote → list and preview/download still resolve (proves disk_path is absolute and unaffected by re-keying). Endpoint contract confirmed: returns {updated:N, from_id, to_id} with N>=1 on valid migration; returns {updated:0} for empty/same/no-matching ids. Frontend: admin login, FilesSec data-testids (files-drop-zone, files-browse-input, btn-build-estimate, toolbar-save, toolbar-load) all mount as expected. Dropped a 5-line tiny .txt via files-browse-input, RFQ class was detected, Build Estimate enabled and clicked. Filled est# (TESTE2E1) + dims; toolbar-save fired createQuote and reassignParserFiles(active.id, saved.id) per Toolbar.jsx onSave L102-106. After reload, TESTE2E1 appeared in the Drafts list (verified via Load Quote modal). Note: data-testid for save is `toolbar-save` not `save-btn` as listed in the request — main agent should update reference doc.

integration_issues.issue: FilesSec.runParseDirect refreshes savedFiles INSIDE the try block (L96). If parseRfq throws (Anthropic 429/budget/timeout), save_parser_file already persisted the bytes but the FE never re-fetches /api/parser/files until filesQuoteId changes via autosave promotion. Estimator sees no Saved RFQ files panel for several seconds. Suggest: move listParserFiles refresh into a finally block (always refresh after parse attempt) since save_parser_file runs BEFORE the anthropic call.

action_items: (Optional polish) FilesSec.jsx L82-100: move the listParserFiles refresh to a finally block so the Saved RFQ files panel appears even when the Anthropic parse step fails (the file is already persisted by then).
Request doc lists the toolbar save data-testid as `save-btn` — it's actually `toolbar-save`. Update the bug-fix reference.
critical_code_review_comments: services/parser_files.py L130-148: reassign_quote_files() correctly guards empty/same ids and uses update_many filtered by deleted_at:null so soft-deleted records aren't resurrected. modified_count returned as the count. Clean.
routes/parser.py L721-734: ReassignBody Pydantic model accepts any strings — endpoint relies on the service-layer guard. Acceptable but a stricter Field(min_length=1) on both would be defensible.

Toolbar.jsx onSave L102-106: reassignParserFiles wrapped in try/empty-catch — silent failure on the reassign. If the migration fails for any reason the user gets a successful Save toast but the files are orphaned. Consider surfacing a non-fatal pushToast(warn) on catch so estimators know to re-attach files. NOT BLOCKING.

FilesSec.jsx L17 filesQuoteId = s.quoteId || active?.id — exactly matches the bug-fix description. After save, state.quoteId is set, so subsequent listParserFiles calls go to the right id. useEffect dependency on filesQuoteId at L46 ensures re-fetch on id change.

Disk paths in parser_files.disk_path are absolute and not migrated on reassign (by design — confirmed in services docstring L139-141). preview_file and download_file resolve correctly post-reassign. Verified.

success_rate.frontend: Mounting + Save + reload flow verified; saved-rfq-files panel refresh timing flagged as minor

seed_data_creation: Created a draft 'TESTE2E1' via UI during testing (visible in Drafts). Backend HTTP test creates+deletes a `reassign_lifecycle.txt` parser_files record per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reassign endpoint and full lifecycle proven at backend HTTP layer. If retesting frontend: the data-testid is `toolbar-save` (not `save-btn`). The saved-rfq-files panel only appears AFTER the first successful listParserFiles returns non-empty — which happens (a) on the post-parse refresh inside the try-block of FilesSec.runParseDirect, or (b) when filesQuoteId changes (local→draft autosave / draft→quote save). If parse fails, expect a brief window where the panel is missing.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: parser_files saved with quote_id = active.id (a transient `local-xxx` tab id). On first autosave the tab id was replaced with a server draft uuid, orphaning the files. On Save Quote a fresh quote uuid was generated, orphaning them again. Fix verified: (1) /api/parser/files/reassign re-keys all matching parser_files docs via update_many; disk paths are absolute so preview/download still resolve. (2) QuoteContext autosave calls reassignParserFiles(localId, draftId) on the local→draft promotion. (3) Toolbar.onSave calls reassignParserFiles(active.id, saved.id) on Save Quote. (4) FilesSec uses filesQuoteId = state.quoteId || active.id so the listParserFiles query always targets the current owner. Backend HTTP lifecycle test exercises the entire chain and asserts file remains preview-able after both migrations.
